headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by TCS and HCLTech.
summary: TCS reported ₹73,188 cr revenue, up 11.2% YoY, and net profit of ₹13,884 cr. HCLTech posted ₹35,620 cr revenue, up 11.5% YoY, with strong AI earnings. Most peers have not released results, but exchange data shows double‑digit growth for Infosys, LTM, and OFSS. Wipro's revenue rose modestly YoY, reflecting mixed demand.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech highlighted AI revenue as a key driver, with AI contributing over 10% of TCS's top line and HCLTech's AI earnings growing 78% YoY.

themes.title: Steady margin performance
themes.detail: Operating margins remained stable around mid‑20% for TCS and above 30% for HCLTech, indicating pricing power despite services deflation pressures.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and profit growth, strong AI contribution and stable margins.
Robust AI revenue growth (78% YoY) and solid profit expansion.

laggards.why: Revenue fell 1% YoY and margin pressure at 15.1%.
Results not released; market awaiting guidance.
